description: Stage 5 knowledge promotion (knowledge/wisdom.py promote_pending_candidates and _promote_failure_candidate) writes a permanent failure_modes KB-failure json for any action signature with at least 2 trials in a failure ladder state. Stage 4 appends several ACT-REV and ACT-FIND ledger rows per pull request whose target embeds the flow's own unique branch, so ordinary review iterations inside one flow reach 2 trials within minutes and every multi-reviewer pull request commits 3 to 21 spurious KB-failure files (about 90 percent of the 3,200 existing files span under one hour, i.e. one flow).
goal: A failure mode is promoted only from evidence that is not intra-flow Stage 4 review chatter: records whose action ids are ACT-REV or ACT-FIND rows of a single flow never produce a KB-failure file, while repeated failures from separate flows or non-review actions still promote as before. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit the module budgets file or any budget-check script; wisdom.py must not grow, so put the new predicate in promotion_rules.py (or another module already within budget) and keep every touched module within its current line budget.
rationale: Stops spurious KB-failure files that bloat the repository, are scanned on every CI lint run and cause add/add conflicts between parallel pull requests, and restores signal to the failure-mode knowledge base. Pruning existing files is out of scope.
acceptance_criteria: A pure predicate in knowledge/promotion_rules.py returns true when every record backing a failure candidate is an ACT-REV or ACT-FIND row and all rows belong to one flow (same intent id or same flow branch in the target); _promote_failure_candidate returns None for such candidates and persists no KB-failure file, in dry-run and normal mode.
A failure candidate with at least two distinct flows' evidence, or with any non-review action row, still promotes exactly as before (same kb_id, payload and file).
The success-pattern promotion path and the existing seen-promoted de-duplication behave unchanged.

New tests in tests/test_failure_promotion_review_chatter.py cover: several ACT-REV/ACT-FIND rows in one flow produce no KB-failure file; the same failures across two flows still promote; a non-review repeated failure still promotes; the tests fail on the old code and pass on the new.
Existing tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_wisdom.py, test_knowledge.py and test_promotion_idempotence.py keep passing, edited only where they asserted the removed behaviour.
No other file changes; wisdom.py and promotion_rules.py stay within their current line budgets; uv run pytest passes for the touched and neighbouring knowledge tests.
